# Note analyser goldens

This directory contains frozen Chromium Web Audio analyser captures for every
single-note WAV fixture under `tests/fixtures/audio`.

Each `*.chromium-analyser.json` was generated by
`scripts/generate-note-analyser-goldens.mjs`. The script opens Chromium with
`--use-file-for-fake-audio-capture=<fixture.wav>`, routes that fake microphone
stream through `AudioContext -> MediaStreamSource -> AnalyserNode`, and records
per-frame values from:

- `AnalyserNode.getFloatTimeDomainData`, reduced to `rms`
- `AnalyserNode.getFloatFrequencyData`, stored as `frequencyDb`

These files are used by `npm run notefingerprint` to test single-note onset
recognition against frozen browser analyser data without launching Chromium on
every fingerprint run.

Regenerate these goldens with:

```bash
npm run notefingerprint:goldens
```

Regeneration is required whenever the note analyser capture path changes, for
example when changing `fftSize`, frame cadence, Web Audio wiring, the
`getFloatFrequencyData` capture logic in the note exercises, or the source WAV
fixtures.

The root `manifest.json` records the source WAV, expected pitch, golden file,
and frame count for each frozen fixture.
